title: A full wake thread starts a new one, so a page save still wakes the writer
why: At 11:33 CST Nov 6 the Cockpit's wake thread b9ad3b14 hit the comment limit (100). The page sends each Send's wake comment into the stored thread (localStorage waiting.thread), and on any error but not_found it gives up quietly. So from now on a save writes the answers but wakes no session.

Done means: when the stored thread refuses a comment for any reason (limit, resolved, gone), the page starts a new thread on the h1 anchor, stores its id, and the wake still lands; a test drives the limit error. Until it lands, the writer reads answers and asks at each wake from any other source, and the owner may need to tell a session in chat after a save.
